name: Business Banking App — Design System
organization: A major Israeli bank (client, via Zemingo)
context: A client engagement at Zemingo for one of Israel's major banks (name withheld — confidential client work): the design system for the bank's business-banking app. The client is never named publicly; the agent says 'a major Israeli bank'.
summary: The design system for a major Israeli bank's business-banking app, built by Boaz's design team at Zemingo and delivered. An atomic library — colors and type through text fields, tables, filters, date pickers, cards, modals and system pages — with dedicated accessibility tracks and a Transitions layer that specifies micro-interaction behavior. The showcase piece is a marketing clip designed with AI from the app's store screens, closing on a CTA to launch an interactive prototype built the same way.

Never name the bank. Show the marketing clip; it is built from the app's own store screens.

Tell the workflow story: the design system's specs and the app's marketing screens become working artifacts with AI — the showcase clip was designed and built from the store screens in one session, and an interactive prototype (reachable from the clip's CTA) is next. Show the clip and let it play. Never name the bank.
